catalog.container_strategy: Install the complete dataset-import wheel group with --no-index --require-hashes into its independent CPython 3.12 environment. Import compiler_playground from the matching project source or install its local wheel explicitly.
catalog.purpose: Prepare local Hugging Face and Parquet snapshots into frozen compiler datasets; optional isolated dependency closure.
